title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NTIGASHIRA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NTIGASHIRA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00123/2025/CA (Kanyange, J. P.) 12 Ukuboza
2025]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
zemejwe n’Umucamanza, igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye
munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15).
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ntigashira yakurikiranweho icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana w’umukobwa
w’imyaka 17, ubwo yabanye nawe nk’umugabo n’umugore mu gihe cy’amezi 6, aregwa mu
Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Muhanga, Ubushinjacyaha bumusabira igihano cyo gufungwa burundu.
Ntigashira yaburanye yemera icyaha asaba ko yagabanyirizwa igihano akajya kumwitaho, kuko
babanye mu rwego rwo kumufasha.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko Uregwa ahamwa n’icyaha akurikiranweho,
rumuhanisha igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu. Uregwa yajuriye bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru,
urugereko rwa Nyanza asaba ko yagabanyirizwa igihano, akaba asaba imbabazi kuko atashishoje
ngo amenye imyaka y’uwo mwana. Ubushinjacyaha nabwo bwamusabiye ko yagabanyirizwa
igihano agahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25.
Urukiko Rukuru rushingiye ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha rwagabanyirije Uregwa igihano,
rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 15. Uregwa nabwo ntiyishimiye icyemezo cy’Urukiko Rukuru
kuko yakijuririye muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko yajuriye kugira ngo agabanyirizwe
igihano no kugisubikirwa.
Muri uru rubanza, Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko Uregwa atakongera kugabanyirizwa igihano kuko
gikwiranye n’icyaha yakoze kandi kigabanyije, dore ko icyaha yakoze gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu ariko we akaba yarahanishijwe imyaka 15, ko kandi icyo gihano kitasubikwa nk’uko
abisaba kuberako igihano gishobora gusubikwa ari ikitarengeje imyaka 5.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’Umucamanza, igihano
cy’igifungo cya burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi
n’itanu (15).
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.
Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 49,
64 n’iya 133.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00262/2025/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Musabyimana Valens Juvénal, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 28/11/2025.

RPAA00076/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Burindwi Jean Bosco, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/01/2025.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Ku wa 21/01/2025, Ntigashira Jean Pierre yatangiye kubana nk’umugore n’umugabo
n’umwana w’umukobwa wari ufite imyaka cumi n’irindwi (17) wahawe izina rya U.M1 mu manza
zabanje, bamarana amezi atandatu, bimaze kumenyekana Ntigashira Jean Pierre atangira
gukurikiranwa.
[2] Nyuma y’iperereza, Ubushinjacyaha bwamureze mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Muhanga
icyaha cyo gusambanya umwana, bushingiye ku kuba yareyeye icyaha, ku mvugo
z’abatangabuhamya no ku mvugo z’umwana wasambanyijwe, bumusabira igifungo cya burundu.
[3] Ntigashira Jean Pierre yaburanye yemera icyaha, avuga ko yabanye na U.M. mu rwego
rwo kumufasha, asaba ko yagabanyirizwa igihano akajya kumwitaho.
[4] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RP00375/2021/TGI/MHG ku wa 06/04/2021, rusanga hari
ibimenyetso bihamya ko Ntigashira Jean Pierre yakoze icyaha akurikiranweho, birimo kuba
yaremeye ko yabanye na U.M nk’umugore n’umugabo, uko kwemera kukaba gushimangirwa
n’imvugo z’abatangabuhamya bamushinja na raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko mu gitsina cya U.M
hari harimo amasohoro ya vuba, rumuhanisha igifungo cya burundu.
[5] Ntigashira Jean Pierre yajuriye mu Rukiko Rukuru/Urugereko rwa Nyanza asaba
kugabanyirizwa igihano kuko yakundanye na U.M., aganira n’iwabo ibyo kubana na we, akaba
asaba imbabazi kuko atashishoje ngo amenye imyaka ye.
[6] Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ko nabwo busanga Ntigashira Jean Pierre yagabanyirizwa
igihano agahanishwa igifungo cy’imyaka 25.
[7] Urukiko rwaciye urubanza RPA00544/2021/HC/NYZ ku wa 17/01/2025, rusanga kuba ari
ubwa mbere Ntigashira Jean Pierre akurikiranweho icyaha mu buryo buzwi no kuba nta kigaragaza
ko yari asanganwe indi myitwarire mibi, yagabanyirizwa igihano, rumuhanisha igifungo
cy’imyaka 15.
[8] Ntigashira Jean Pierre yongeye ajurira mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza rwandikwa kuri
RPAA00123/2025/CA, iburanisha ribera mu ruhame ku wa 04/12/2025, Ntigashira yunganiwe na
Me Shema T Gerald, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Rukaka Gallican, Umushinjacyaha ku
rwego rw’Igihugu.
[9] Mu myanzuro y’ubujurire no mu miburanire, Ntigashira Jean Pierre n’umwunganira
bavuga ko yajuriye kugira ngo agabanyirizwe igihano no kugisubikirwa.
1 Yahawe iri zina kuko ari umwana.

[10] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko iyo mpamvu y’ubujurire nta shingiro ifite, kuko
Ntigashira Jean Pierre yagabanyirijwe bihagijwe kandi mu buryo bukurikije amategeko.
[11] Ikibazo kigomba gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza ni ukumenya niba Ntigashira Jean Pierre
yakongera kugabanyiriza igihano.
I. ISESENGURA RY’IKIBAZO KIRI MU RUBANZA
Kumenya niba Ntigashira Jean Pierre yakongera kugabanyirizwa igihano
[12] Ntigashira Jean Pierre n’umwunganira bavuga ko ubujurire bwe bugamije gusaba kongera
kugabanyirizwa igihano no kugisubikirwa, kuko ajya kubana na U.M. atari azi ko atujuje imyaka
y’ubukure kuko n’umuryango we wari ubizi, ariko ntibamubwira ko ataruzuza imyaka y’ubukure.
[13] Ku birebana n’amategeko, bavuga ko hagashingirwa ku ngingo ya 2 (b) y’Itegeko Nº
059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya
ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, agahabwa kimwe cya kabiri cy’igihano gito giteganywa n’itegeko,
rukanashingira ku ngingo ya 49 y’iryo tegeko iteganya ibyo umucamanza ashingiraho mu gutanga
igihano, ruzirikana ko igihano atari igifungo cy’igihe kirekire ahubwo ari ukugira ngo uwakosheje
agororoke, kandi Ntigashira akaba yumva yaragororotse bihagije, bityo ko igihano yahawe
cyagabanywa ndetse kigasubikwa, ko kandi imanza bagaragaje mu myanzuro batakizishingiyeho.
[14] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko Ntigashira Jean Pierre atakongera kugabanyirizwa
igihano kuko cyagabanyijwe mu buryo buhagije kandi bukurikije amategeko, cyane cyane ingingo
ya 2 (a) y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, kuko icyaha yakoze gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu.
[15] Avuga kandi ko Ntigashira Jean Pierre yahawe igihano gikwiranye n’icyaha yakoze kandi
kigabanyije kuko icyaha yakoze gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu ariko we akaba yarahanishijwe
imyaka 15, ko kandi icyo gihano kitasubikwa nk’uko abisaba kuko igihano gishobora gusubikwa
ari ikitarengeje imyaka 5.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[16] Impaka muri uru rubanza zishingiye ku kumenya niba igihano Ntigashira Jean Pierre
yahanishijwe cy’imyaka 15 cyagabanywa, no kumenya niba yasubikirwa igihano.
[17] Ingingo ya 133 (5) y’Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange nk’uko ryahinduwe kugeza ubu ivuga ko iyo umuntu mukuru asambanyije umwana
bigakurikirwa no kumugira umugabo cyangwa umugore, igihano kiba igifungo cya burundu.
[18] Naho ikibazo kirebana n’igihano gito gishobora guhabwa uwahamijwe icyaha gihanishwa
igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu mu gihe hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, cyatanzweho umurongo
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire mu manza zitandukanye harimo urubanza RPAA00076/2024/CA
rwaciwe ku wa 20/01/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Burindwi Jean Bosco, Urukiko rukaba
rwarasesenguye ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2 y’Itegeko N°059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023

yahinduye ingingo ya 60 y’Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano
muri rusange2, rusobanura ko iyo hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha zemejwe n’Umucamanza,
igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igifungo
cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15). Uwo murongo wakomeje gukurikizwa mu zindi manza, urwa nyuma
akaba ari urubanza RPAA00262/2025/CA rwaciwe ku wa 28/11/2025 haburana Ubushinjacyaha
na Musabyimana Valens Juvénal.
[19] Nk’uko imikirize y’urubanza rujurirwa ibigaragaza, Urukiko Rukuru, rwagabanyirije
Ntigashira Jean Pierre igihano cy’igifungo cya burundu yari yahanishijwe ku rwego rwa mbere,
rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15), rushingiye ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha
rwasobanuye.
[20] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga harebwe uburyo ibihano bishobora kugabanywa iyo hari
impamvu nyoroshyacyaha nk’uko byatanzweho umurongo n’uru Rukiko mu manza zavuzwe
haruguru, hakanarebwa igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) Ntigashira Jean Pierre
yahanishijwe nyuma yo kugabanyirizwa igihano, icyo gihano kitakongera kugabanywa kuko
cyagabanyijwe mu buryo bukurikije amategeko kandi kikaba aricyo gito gishobora gutangwa.
[21] Ku bisabwa na Ntigashira ko mu kumugabanyiriza igihano hashingirwa ku ngingo ya 2
agace ka (b) y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa
30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, agahabwa kimwe cya kabiri cy’igihano gito
giteganywa n’itegeko, Urukiko rurasanga nta shingiro bifite, kuko icyaha cyamuhamye cyo
gusambanya umwana bigakurikirwa no kubana nawe nk’umugabo n’umugore gihanishwa
igifungo cya burundu nk’uko byavuzwe haruguru, haba hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha
hagashingirwa ku gace ka (a) k’ingingo ya 2 y’Itegeko N°059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023
ryavuzwe haruguru, iteganya ko igihano gito gishobora gutangwa ari icy’imyaka 15, ndetse
n’ingingo ya 49 y’Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri
rusange ikaba itashingirwaho ngo ahabwe igihano yifuza, kuko nk’uko byatanzweho umurongo
n’uru Rukiko mu manza zavuzwe haruguru, igihano yahawe ni cyo gito gishobora gutangwa ku
birebana n’icyaha cyamuhamye.
[22] Urukiko rurasanga kandi icyo gihano kitasubikwa kuko hashingiwe ku biteganywa
n’ingingo ya 64 y’Itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri
rusange nk’uko ryahinduwe, Urukiko rushobora gusubika igihano iyo icyo uregwa yakatiwe
kitarenze imyaka itanu (5).
[23] Hashingiwe ku byasobanuwe, Urukiko rurasanga igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15)
Ntigashira Jean Pierre yahanishijwe kitakongera kugabanywa ndetse kitanasubikwa, bityo hakaba
hagumyeho imikirize y’urubanza rwajuririwe.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’ URUKIKO
[24] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwatanzwe na Ntigashira Jean Pierre nta shingiro bufite.
2 Iyo ngingo iteganya ko iyo umucamanza yemeje impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, ashobora kugabanya igihano, ko
igifungo cya burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15.

[25] Rwemeje ko urubanza RPA00544/2021/HC/NYZ rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru/ Urugereko
rwa Nyanza ku wa 17/01/2025, rugumanye agaciro mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[26] Rutegetse ko igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) Ntigashira Jean Pierre yahanishijwe
kigumyeho.
